options.description: Commit your two hook-limit answers on the branch (fixing the bad link on the second one), then move main's copies into a backup folder outside the repository. main's checkout stops holding the fast-forward; nothing is lost, since the backup can be put back.
options.label: Move them off main (Recommended)

options.description: Nothing moves. plumb-f3's eval fixes wait until the design-review work lands.
options.label: Leave them; f3 waits

payload.question: Copies of the design-review records sit uncommitted in the main checkout (the intent, its 9 requirements and about 24 decisions). They're stopping plumb-f3 from moving main forward to land its three eval fixes. The branch already has its own, newer versions of all of them except two: your hook-limit answers (keep 60/90 s; keep 10 s for the two fast hooks). What should I do?
